name: Sample Mobile Notary
metaDescription: Affordable mobile notary services that come to your home, office or a location of your choice. Same-day appointments available, 7 days a week.

title.en: Notary services that come to you

lead.en: Fast, efficient mobile service for all your legal documents.
lead.zh: 快捷高效的流動公證服務，為您處理各類法律文件。

example.en: Such as affidavits of service, divorce or student-aid applications.
example.zh: 例如服務宣誓書、離婚宣誓書或學生資助申請。

example.en: Such as proof-of-life or residency attestations.
example.zh: 例如生命證明或居住證明。

example.en: Such as letters supporting a visitor's travel application.
example.zh: 例如支持訪客旅行申請的邀請信。

example.en: Such as declarations of identity, marital status or progress payment.
example.zh: 例如身份、婚姻狀況或進度付款的聲明。

example.en: Such as consent letters for children travelling without both parents.

text.en: We come to your home, office or a location of your choice.
text.zh: 我們可上門到您的住所、辦公室或指定地點。

text.en: Same-day appointments are available for urgent requests.
text.zh: 緊急情況可安排即日預約。

text.en: Your documents are handled with the utmost privacy.
text.zh: 您的文件會以最嚴格的私隱標準處理。

text.en: Transparent fees with no hidden costs.
text.zh: 收費清楚，沒有隱藏費用。

intro.en: We provide reliable, professional mobile notary services. Our mission is to offer convenient and affordable notarization for individuals and businesses, handled with care and attention to detail.
intro.zh: 我們提供可靠而專業的流動公證服務。我們的使命是為個人及企業提供便捷、價格合理的公證服務，並細心處理每一個細節。

text.en: We proudly serve Sample City, Sample Town and the surrounding areas. Not sure if you are covered? Get in touch.
text.zh: 我們服務範例市、範例鎮及周邊地區。不確定是否涵蓋您的地址？歡迎聯絡我們。

paragraphs.en: Replace this paragraph with a short biography: your background, experience and what clients can expect when they work with you.
paragraphs.zh: 請以簡短個人介紹取代這段文字：您的背景、經驗，以及客戶可以期待的服務。

paragraphs.en: Please note: a notary public cannot give legal or immigration advice.
paragraphs.zh: 請注意：公證人不能提供法律或移民方面的意見。

payment.zh: 只接受現金或電子轉賬

desc.zh: 第一個公證簽名和印章

desc.en: Additional notary signature and seal, up to the 10th
desc.zh: 每個額外公證簽名和印章（最多到第十個）

text.en: Book online or contact us to arrange a convenient time.
text.zh: 網上預約或聯絡我們安排合適時間。

text.en: We meet you in person, check your ID and review the documents.
text.zh: 我們會當面核對您的身份證明及文件。

text.en: Your documents are notarized promptly, securely and professionally.
text.zh: 您的文件會迅速、安全而專業地完成公證。

form.subject: Subject
form.consent: I agree to be contacted about my enquiry. You can unsubscribe at any time.
form.success: Thanks! Your email app should open with the message ready to send.

hoursNote.en: By appointment only. Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance.
hoursNote.zh: 只接受預約。如需取消，請最少提前24小時通知。

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information this website collects and how it is used. It is a template: have it reviewed against your own practices and local privacy law before publishing.

sections.title: Information you give us
sections.text: If you contact us through the form, by email or by phone, we receive the details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number and message. We use them only to respond to your enquiry and to arrange and carry out your appointment.

sections.title: Information collected automatically
sections.text: Like most websites, our web server records basic technical information such as IP address, browser type, pages requested and timestamps. This data does not identify you personally and is used for security and to keep the site working.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.text: This website does not use advertising cookies. If we add analytics or other third-party tools in future, we will list them here.

sections.title: Your documents
sections.text: Documents you bring to an appointment are handled in confidence. We do not keep copies unless the service requires it and we tell you so.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.text: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only when required by law or when you ask us to.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You may ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by contacting us using the details below.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

text.en: Appointments are by booking only. Tell us what you need and we will confirm a time.
text.zh: 服務只接受預約。請告訴我們您的需要，我們會確認時間。
